text:
sasha: Ran a set of nsys+perfetto traces on the 4xA100 cluster while repro-ing the KV-cache regression. Putting raw highlights here.

mateo: thanks — was the trace with kernel-selector v2 enabled or the fallback?

sasha: selector=v2, but we toggled heuristic 'prefer_small_kernels' off for one run. This one is the run where latency spikes at ~120 tokens.

sasha: perfetto flame snippet (trimmed):
```
GPU0: conv_fwd  | wait (nvlink) | kernel_small | all_reduce | kv_write
GPU1: conv_fwd  | kernel_small  | wait (nvlink) | all_reduce | kv_write
GPU2: conv_fwd  | kernel_large  | all_reduce | kv_write
GPU3: conv_fwd  | kernel_large  | all_reduce | kv_write
```

anika: looks like GPU1 hits NVLink wait before its small kernel completes -> serialization. Did you collect NCCL traces?

profiler-bot: NCCL timeline summary (from nsys export):
```
NCCL op: all_reduce | total_time=52.3ms | overlap_with_compute=18.9ms | gap_before=7.2ms | gap_after=6.1ms
Per-GPU: g0=51ms, g1=58ms (+7ms skew), g2=49ms, g3=53ms
```

mateo: that +7ms skew on g1 maps to the kernel selector decision — g1 used the smaller kernel and then hit an extra synchronization. Can you paste the kernel launch list for g1/g2?

sasha: paste (trimmed):
```
[G1] launch: matmul_small(seq=64) -> softmax -> gelu -> kv_encode -> nvlink_wait -> all_reduce
[G2] launch: matmul_large(seq=64) -> softmax -> gelu -> all_reduce
```

devon: possible cause: selector picked matmul_small which has worse occupancy for that SM config, so it finishes sooner but leaves threads idle waiting for NCCL rendezvous. Also KV encode on G1 schedules a memcpy after kernel, pushing NVLink DMA later.

anika: hypothesis: KV cache handshake on leader rank inserts a small host->device memcpy that races with NCCL progress on that GPU. Repro: run with KV_HANDSHAKE=off and NCCL_ASYNC=1 to see if overlap improves.

mateo: also try forcing kernel_large on all ranks to see if uniform kernel choices reduce NCCL skew. If skew vanishes, we know kernel selection variability is the root cause.

profiler-bot: suggested command snippet:
```bash
NSYS_WRITE_PATH=./traces nsys profile --trace=cuda,nvtx,nccl -o out ./run_inference --model r-infer:1 --seq 64 --batch-dist uniform && perfetto trace out.qdrep
```

sasha: plan: 1) rerun with KV_HANDSHAKE=off & NCCL_ASYNC=1, 2) rerun forcing kernel_large via selector override, 3) collect per-GPU nvprof for the problematic time window. I'll post the new traces here. :eyes: 

devon: SGTM. If that doesn't fix it, we should add a short delay before NCCL start in the runtime to let DMA complete (cheap mitigation) and file a follow-up to tune the selector heuristics.

mateo: thanks — please tag me on the new traces.

sasha: will do.
